experiments.name: Chamber Drift
experiments.productUse: Page hero backdrop with slow parallax depth, like the entrance hall of the product.

experiments.name: Lattice Weave
experiments.productUse: Section background; a flat voxel lattice that ripples gently to signal a live surface.

experiments.name: Haze Columns
experiments.productUse: Backdrop for sign-in and ceremonial pages; a colonnade with drifting light beams.

experiments.name: Ink Tide
experiments.productUse: Footer ambient strip; a low voxel tide that slowly swells and recedes.

experiments.name: Starfield Depth
experiments.productUse: Empty-page backdrop (404, maintenance); sparse voxel stars with pointer parallax.

experiments.name: Tilt Parallax Card
experiments.productUse: Product and agent cards; a voxel stack that tilts with the pointer to give cards physical depth.

experiments.name: Hover Assemble
experiments.productUse: Nav logos and link hovers; scattered voxels snap together into the mark on hover.

experiments.name: Press Pad
experiments.productUse: Primary call-to-action feedback; a voxel key that physically depresses on press.

experiments.name: Flip Cube
experiments.productUse: Two-state toggles (theme, view mode); a cube that rolls between two styled faces.

experiments.name: Stack Tick
experiments.productUse: Form confirmation; a voxel checkmark that builds in when a step completes.

experiments.name: Focus Frame
experiments.productUse: Input focus affordance; a thin voxel frame that lights up around the active field.

experiments.name: Voxel Bar Relay
experiments.productUse: Dashboard stats; a 3D bar chart whose columns grow and reorder as numbers change.

experiments.name: Terrain Heightmap
experiments.productUse: Activity and network visualizations; a voxel terrain whose elevation is the data.

experiments.name: Vault Fill
experiments.productUse: Staking progress; a glass vault that fills with gold voxels as the staked share grows.

experiments.name: Pipeline Track
experiments.productUse: Multi-stage progress; a token advances along an isometric track, one station per stage.

experiments.name: Tree Growth
experiments.productUse: Research-tree progress; branches assemble voxel by voxel as nodes unlock.

experiments.name: Podium Bids
experiments.productUse: Live leaderboards; podium columns that grow and swap places as rankings change.

experiments.productUse: Page-to-page handoff; the current scene dissolves into voxels that reassemble as the next motif.

experiments.name: Tunnel Warp
experiments.productUse: Entering the app; a fast camera push through a voxel chamber, under 600 ms.

experiments.name: Curtain Slats
experiments.productUse: Modal and drawer reveals; vertical voxel slats rotate open in sequence.

experiments.name: Scatter Handoff
experiments.productUse: Hero-to-content handoff; the mark scatters into depth and regroups as the next section's sigil.

experiments.name: Voxel Burst
experiments.productUse: Success moments (claimed, minted, launched); a one-shot burst of brand-colored voxels.

experiments.name: Gavel Strike
experiments.productUse: Auction won; a voxel gavel strikes and a shockwave ring ripples out.

experiments.name: Coronation
experiments.productUse: Onboarding and formation complete; a crown assembles from falling voxels with a gold sheen.

experiments.name: Vault Jackpot
experiments.productUse: Rewards claimed; vault doors swing open and gold voxels spill out.

experiments.name: Stack Build Loader
experiments.productUse: Indeterminate loading; a small voxel column builds and unbuilds in a calm loop.

experiments.name: Progress Ring
experiments.productUse: Determinate progress; a ring of voxels fills clockwise toward completion.
